messages:
sam: quick thread: should the gateway send a "gw-quiesce-handshake" when it emits the first response frame so downstream proxies stop speculative retries? thinking about duplicated side-effects on hedged requests.
lee: yes, we need an explicit contract. otherwise hedging can replay non-idempotent work after a partial client receive.
zoe: i like a two-way handshake: gateway sets header `x-rw-quiesce: 1` and edge ACKs with a trailer `x-rw-quiesce-ack: v1` at stream end if it persisted state for resume.
tom: note: ACK trailer implies the runtime supports resumable checkpoints. we should allow edges to noop if they don't support it and gateway must fallback to non-resumable billing/visibility.
sam: product asks how to bill partials. proposal: bill to the last committed checkpoint (if acked) else bill to last confirmed chunk. makes resume determinism clear.
lee: operations: add metrics `edge.quiesce.recv` and `edge.quiesce.ack_persisted`. also trace tag `quiesce=true`.
zoe: security: make resume tokens opaque + encrypted, short TTL, stored in KVS with rotation. expose only an id to gateway, not raw token.
tom: rollout: gateway should only emit header when it detects edge runtime >= 1.8 or feature-flagged per-customer. that avoids breaking older proxies.
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for gateway v2.4.0 to staging (owner: @sam). :rocket:
sam: i'll write a concise RFC with header/trailer names, metrics, and rollout notes. can i get +1s?
lee: +1
zoe: +1
